documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Board Meeting Proposed To Be Held On 2Nd November, 2026 Pursuant To Regulation 29 Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 ('Listing Regulations'
Intimation Of Appointment Of Investor Relations (IR) And Public Relations (PR) Agency
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: U. Y. Fincorp Limited reported strong financial performance for FY 2025-26, with revenue from operations increasing to ₹16,164.13 Lakhs and profit before tax rising significantly to ₹6,664.38 Lakhs. The company expanded its lending portfolio to ₹35,652.97 Lakhs as of March 31, 2026, and diversified its offerings by introducing equipment financing under the 'GrowU.money' brand and small-ticket loans through a partnership with Fintech Cloud Private Limited under the 'Fundobaba' brand. Management remains optimistic about long-term economic growth and financial inclusion opportunities, maintaining a disciplined approach to asset quality, liquidity, and risk management.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the Indian economy maintained strong growth momentum during FY 2025-26, supported by domestic consumption, investment activity, manufacturing, and services.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian economy maintained strong growth momentum during FY 2025-26, supported by domestic consumption, investment activity, manufacturing and services.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted that increasing formalisation of the economy, financial inclusion, digitalisation, and growing demand for organised credit created significant opportunities for NBFCs.
demand_outlook.quote: Increasing formalisation of the economy, financial inclusion, digitalisation and growing demand for organised credit have created significant opportunities for NBFCs.

demand_outlook.claim: The outlook of the business is described as very exciting with opportunities to do something unique and exceptional.
demand_outlook.quote: The outlook of the business is very exciting and we take it as an opportunity to do something unique and exceptional.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that credit demand is projected to grow by 13.5-14.0 percent, especially among MSMEs and retail.
demand_outlook.quote: As the country progresses, demand for credit is likely to remain strong, especially among Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) and retail, and is projected to grow by 13.5-14.0 per cent.

capex_expansion.claim: During FY 2025-26, the company diversified its product portfolio by introducing equipment financing under the 'GrowU.money' brand.
capex_expansion.quote: During FY 2025-26, we further diversified our product portfolio by introducing Equipment Financing under the “GrowU.money” brand.

capex_expansion.claim: The company entered into a contractual joint venture agreement on April 9, 2025, with Fintech Cloud Private Limited to expand business into small ticket size personal and business loans under the brand name 'FUNDOBABA'.
capex_expansion.quote: During the period under review, the Board of Directors of the Company at their meeting held on 9th April, 2025, inter alia considered and approved the contractual joint venture agreement dated 9th April, 2025 entered into by the Company with Fintech Cloud Private Limited (FCPL) for expansion of its business into the field on small ticket size Personal and Business Loan under its new brand name “FUNDOBABA”.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board of Directors approved the opening of a new branch office at Lucknow on May 3, 2024.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year under review, the Board of Directors at its meeting held on 3rd May, 2024 inter alia considered and approved the proposal of opening of the Company’s new branch office at Lucknow for the purpose of expansion of its business operation in the area of Lucknow under the brand name “GrowU.Money”.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board of Directors approved a contractual joint venture agreement with Fintech Cloud Private Limited on April 9, 2025, for expansion into small ticket size personal and business loans under the brand name FUNDOBABA.
capex_expansion.quote: The Board of Directors of the Company at their meeting held on 9th April, 2025, inter alia considered and approved the contractual joint venture agreement dated 9th April, 2025 entered into by the Company with Fintech Cloud Private Limited (FCPL) for expansion of its business into the field on small ticket size Personal and Business Loan under its new brand name “FUNDOBABA”.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is expanding its business operations into central and eastern Uttar Pradesh covering Prayagraj, Varanasi, Sonbhadra, Ayodhya, Deoria, and Gorakhpur regions.
capex_expansion.quote: Since GrowU has received positive response under its pilot project in the areas of lucknow and Kanpur, it is now inter alia expanding further into central and eastern Uttar Pradesh covering Prayagraj, Varanasi, Sonbhadra, Ayodhya, Deoria and Gorakhpur regions.

capex_expansion.claim: The company entered into various Business Correspondent Agreements for business expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company had also entered into various Business Correspondent Agreements for expansion of its business.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is set to launch loans against property to diversify its product offerings.
capex_expansion.quote: To further diversify its offerings, the Company is set to launch a new product – loans against property.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved Revenue from Operations of ₹16,164.13 Lakhs for FY 2025-26 compared to ₹11,104.61 Lakhs in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: During the year under review, the Company achieved Revenue from Operations of ₹16,164.13 Lakhs, as against ₹11,104.61 Lakhs in the previous year.

margins_costs.claim: Profit Before Tax increased substantially to ₹6,664.38 Lakhs for FY 2025-26 compared with ₹1,693.88 Lakhs in FY 2024-25.
margins_costs.quote: Profit Before Tax increased substantially to ₹6,664.38 Lakhs, compared with ₹1,693.88 Lakhs in FY 2024-25.

orders_capacity.claim: The lending portfolio expanded meaningfully to reach ₹35,652.97 Lakhs as at March 31, 2026, compared with ₹27,457.34 Lakhs as at March 31, 2025.
orders_capacity.quote: Our lending portfolio also expanded meaningfully during the year, reaching ₹35,652.97 Lakhs as at March 31, 2026, compared with ₹27,457.34 Lakhs as at March 31, 2025.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has disbursed loans to more than 18,000 customers across India.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company has disbursed loans to more than 18,000 customers across India.

orders_capacity.claim: The company disbursed small-ticket loans with a monthly run rate of approximately Rs. 100 Lakhs at an interest rate between 24-33% p.a.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company has also digitalized the onboarding disbursement process of small ticket sized Loan with the monthly run rate of approx Rs. 100 Lakhs with an interest rate ranging between 24-33% p.a.

orders_capacity.claim: The company disbursed loans to more than 3,800 customers across Uttar Pradesh through 2 branches and 6 Business Correspondents.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company had disbursed loan to more than 3,800 customers, across more than 2 Customer Locations in Uttar Pradesh, through its network of 2 branches, & 6 Business Correspondents.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved a monthly run rate of approximately Rs. 100 Lakhs for small-ticket sized loans with an interest rate ranging between 24-33% p.a.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company has also digitalized the onboarding disbusrement process of small ticket sized Loan with the monthly run rate of approx Rs. 100 Lakhs with an interest rate ranging between 24-33% p.a.

orders_capacity.claim: The company built a loan portfolio exceeding 14 crore INR while keeping the NPA rate below 2 percent.
orders_capacity.quote: In just one year, Company has built a loan portfolio exceeding 14 crore INR keeping the NPA rate below 2 percent.

orders_capacity.claim: The company added over 3000 active users in the personal and business loan segments.
orders_capacity.quote: The company has added over 3000 active users in the personal and business loan segments.

capital_allocation.claim: The Directors of the company did not recommend any dividend for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, in order to plough back resources for future growth.
capital_allocation.quote: The Directors of your Company do not recommend any dividend for the financial year ended 31st March, 2026 in order to plough back the resources for future growth.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that geopolitical tensions, changing trade policies, commodity price volatility, elevated global debt, and uncertainty in international financial markets continued to influence economic activity.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions, changing trade policies, commodity price volatility, elevated global debt and uncertainty in international financial markets continued to influence economic activity across regions.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the industry continues to face challenges relating to asset quality, competition, funding conditions, interest-rate movements, and an evolving regulatory environment.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, the industry continues to face challenges relating to asset quality, competition, funding conditions, interest-rate movements and an evolving regulatory environment.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that global economic uncertainty is contributed to by ongoing geopolitical conflicts, widespread elevation of debt, extreme weather conditions, and elections in many parts of the world.
risks_headwinds.quote: Multiple factors like the on-going geopolitical conflicts, wide-spread elevation of debt, extreme weather conditions and elections in many parts of the world continue to contribute to the uncertainty of the Global Economic Outlook.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that increasing inflation, domestic political uncertainty, and global economic conditions contribute to the inadequacy of profit.
risks_headwinds.quote: Increasing inflation, domestic political uncertainty and global economic condition contributes to the inadequacy of profit of the Company.

management_commitments.claim: Management intends to expand operations in existing markets, selectively enter newer geographies, and explore organic and inorganic opportunities.
management_commitments.quote: We intend to build upon our existing strengths by expanding our operations in existing markets, selectively entering newer geographies and exploring organic as well as inorganic opportunities, while remaining within our risk appetite.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to expand into the financial market segment and capitalize the setup along with increasing capacity.
management_commitments.quote: Considering the same, your Company intends to expand into financial market segment and capitalize the set up for the same along with increasing capacity as required by the business.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to continue its efforts of mainstreaming financial inclusion and providing affordable credit to customers in the lower half of the socio-economic pyramid.
management_commitments.quote: The Company intends to continue its efforts of mainstreaming financial inclusion and providing affordable credit to customers in the lower half of the socio-economic pyramid.

management_commitments.claim: Mr. Udai Kothari was re-appointed as Executive Chairman and Managing Director for a period of 3 years effective from May 2, 2025.
management_commitments.quote: approval of the Members of the Company be and is hereby accorded for re-appointmente of Mr. Udai Kothari (DIN: 00284256) as Executive Chairman and Managing Director of the Company, for a period of 3 (three) years with effect from May 2, 2025

management_commitments.claim: Mrs. Sangeeta Singh was approved for appointment as a Non-Executive Independent Director for a term of five consecutive years from November 12, 2024 up to November 11, 2029.
management_commitments.quote: for the term of five consecutive years commencing from 12th November, 2024 up to 11th November, 2029, be and is hereby approved.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
